payload.evidence_summary: Compiled 12 active role transfers from real_chemlex_acidamine using 4096 observed source rows and 5 conservative shared-vocabulary value priors. Direction is not transferred as a raw chemical rule; the card transfers role-level evidence strength and only transfers source value priors when source and target fields share the same public descriptor vocabulary.

payload.claim: Frozen measured outcomes from real_chemlex_acidamine can improve finite-pool search on real_buchwald_hartwig through the reaction_role_source_outcome route without reading hidden target outcomes.
payload.failure_condition: Reject the transfer route when calibration does not clear every frozen gain, stability, and confidence requirement against both target anchors.
payload.route_rationale: Reaction tasks share public component roles; offer role-level source-outcome transfer, then let target calibration gate it.

offline_selection_cost.interpretation: Gross policy-replay count, not a count of unique candidates. It is cheap for archived lookup but is not an acceptable cost model for wet-lab deployment.

payload.interpretation_rule: The full route is called continuous only when it improves over the same source-informed initial design with transfer mass fixed to zero. LLM patch credit additionally requires improvement over the fixed data-only route.
